title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta19

## Target zone now means active mowing-task target

This beta separates the user-facing Target zone from the richer internal
navigation intent used by Gate arbitration.

### Changed

- Public **Target zone** now reports only active mowing-task intent.
- Docked, idle and return-to-dock states publish **No active target** instead of
  reviving retained work targets or route segments.
- Fresh Home Assistant mowing commands remain visible immediately.
- Fresh MQTT `partitionIds` are the preferred vendor task-selection source.
- Private-cloud task zone selection is used only when the MQTT task selection is
  stale or unavailable.
- A fresh empty `partitionIds` list is treated as the observed Mow All form and
  falls through to the fresh immediate work target instead of reviving an older
  private-cloud selection.
- Fresh work-target data remains a fallback for active Mow All-style tasks.
- Internal Gate/navigation routing is preserved separately as
  `navigation_target_zone_ids` / `navigation_target_zone_source` and is exposed
  on the Target zone sensor attributes for diagnostics.

### Safety and compatibility

- Gate route arbitration, arrival guards, same-zone command protection and
  cloud confirmation rules are unchanged.
- Zone progress, cycle detection, completion history and vendor trail handling
  are unchanged.
- Regression coverage locks idle/return suppression, multi-zone task selection,
  Mow All fallback, private-cloud fallback and fresh command precedence.
